pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired: prod-usw2 inference-gateway — 5xx rate 5.8% (5m). PagerDuty IN-4512 created and paged oncall. Escalation level: page.

jamie: acked. I'm on it, taking lead.

lee: quick triage — spiky 502/504s from gw-03/gw-04. p50 latency jumped from 45ms -> 420ms. Error percent correlates with requests that have seq_len > 8k tokens.

sarah: any recent deploys?

jamie: no deploys in last 30m from our CI. No config pushes either.

lee: checking proxy logs, looks like kv-cache thrash + backend timeouts. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:15:12Z] gw-03 ERROR upstream_request: status=502, elapsed=3001ms, key=ctx:abc123
[2026-03-17T02:15:13Z] gw-03 WARN kvcache: eviction_rate=0.82, cache_miss=0.67
```

ops-bot: autoscaler observed spike; scaled gw-nodepool by +3 nodes 02:14 UTC.

lee: one node shows repeated OOMKilled on kv-proxy sidecar, maybe GC/heap pressure when handling large KV frames. kubectl output: `gw-kvproxy-7f6b9 CrashLoopBackOff`

sarah: mitigation proposal: 1) divert 30% of traffic away from gw-03/04 to other region/fallback routing, 2) reduce max_concurrency on gateway to ease KV pressure, 3) warm standby for smaller model variant. Which do you want first?

jamie: do 1 and 2 now. I'll coordinate 3 with model routing. Executing: `redwood route update --region prod-usw2 --percent-override gw-03,gw-04=70` (reduces inbound by ~30%). Also lowering gateway max concurrency on gw-03/04 to 8.

pagerbot: action recorded: routing override applied. Concurrency limit updated.

lee: metrics after change (2m): 5xx -> 2.0%, p50 latency -> 120ms. improvement visible.

sarah: jamie, can you flip routing policy to prefer model-variant redwood/opt-lt for 25% of requests (cheap, lower mem) while we stabilize? That will reduce KV pressure.

jamie: done. `redwood model-route set --from inference-gateway --variant redwood/opt-lt --weight 25`

lee: observing further drop, 5xx now 1.1% over 5m. KV eviction rate trending down.

sarah: customer-impact note: internal metric shows ~3% of active sessions experienced degraded responses in the 02:12–02:18 window. CS alerted for top 5 customers with high seq lengths. @sarah will coordinate comms.

jamie: planning follow-up: 1) keep routing override for 30m, 2) schedule node reprovision for gw-03, check memory limits on kv-proxy, 3) run an eval against long-seq workload to reproduce.

ops-bot: scheduled job: reprovision gw-03 at 02:40 UTC.

lee: adding runbook link for reference: /runbooks/kvcache-eviction. Also attaching sampling logs to the PD incident.

pagerbot: PD incident IN-4512 updated: status=investigating -> mitigated. Will auto-clear page if 15m stable.

jamie: thanks team. I'll handoff to infra for the reprovision and follow-up postmortem. Leaving channel open for any regressions. :thumbsup:
